title: marshallia graminifolia subsp. tenuifolia
intro: Marshallia graminifolia subsp. tenuifolia, commonly known as Pale Purple Coneflower, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions including fever, sore throats, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Marshallia graminifolia subsp. tenuifolia include antiseptic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory issues and wound healing. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
